commits.author: loom-oa-dev[bot]
commits.message:
Fix nightly slow test collection imports (#10046)

Let the scheduled slow job collect RolloutEngine and VerifyIT tests from
the repository root. Shared RolloutEngine task, model, and runtime
helpers now live in `rolloutengine.test_support`, so tests no longer
import another test module. VerifyIT's subprocess scorers live in
`verifyit.test_support`, where the bounded worker can reimport them by
package name. The root pytest configuration stays unchanged, and neither
suite changes `sys.path` during collection.

`TESTING.md` now directs shared fixtures to `conftest.py` and importable
helpers to a named support module, with imports checked in both
package-only and repository-wide runs.

The exact RolloutEngine CI command passed locally (138 passed, 5
skipped, 15 deselected). VerifyIT's package-level run passed 16 tests.
The nightly command collected 5 slow tests from 11,839 without import
errors; Pyrefly reported zero errors.

---------

Co-authored-by: loom <claude-max-1@openathena.ai>

commits.author: rjpower
commits.message:
Supply grader dependencies in exported Harbor images (#10035)

Supply ARC's system-Python grader dependencies in exported Harbor
images. Run pytest graders with the source image's
`/opt/tasktrove-pytest` interpreter, which contains pytest-json-report,
and install Verifyit's math extra for math graders. Previously these
images could build successfully but fail before grading because the
selected interpreter lacked the required packages.

ARC Harbor export retains the legacy source Dockerfile and installs
NumPy, Requests and tomli-w for its scorer. It does not reproduce the
native TaskSpec package lock or its version pins. This exception is
limited to ARC inductive and transductive; other agent package-lock
exports remain unsupported. Regenerate affected exports under a new
export version to use the corrected environments.

Addresses the shared-image dependency defect reported on #10034.

commits.author: rjpower
commits.message:
Fix TaskTrove rollout submission and environment failures (#10034)

Reasoning-only final responses now reach grading as empty submissions,
preserving any files the agent wrote. Rollout sessions pass the stop
reason to graders as context; it does not gate grading. Raw provider
responses remain in the trajectory.

TaskTrove ARC tasks declare a shell and the existing Python package
environment. Harbor export retains the source Dockerfile and shared
workspace instead of trying to export the native package lock. Both ARC
recipe versions advance to invalidate converted outputs.

Verifyit scores a missing child module as a failed submission when its
parent is an editable workspace package. Missing top-level dependencies
and trusted-source failures remain unscored. Exact-token continuity
checks are unchanged.

Fixes #10031
